value_stream.name: Freight Procurement, Carrier Management & Freight Audit

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06.1), DC Operations (links to VS-04.2), Supply Planning (links to VS-02), Carrier/3PL, Store (links to VS-07.3)
fields.Trigger: Store replenishment wave (links to VS-02/VS-04/W1368); routing guide (W3500)

workflows.name: Outbound DC-to-Store Freight Planning & Load Tendering

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/DC plan the outbound freight from the replenishment wave" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "Logistics tender the load to the routing-guide carrier" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "DC/Logistics load and ship" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-560 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Execution, Routing Guide & Visibility (PA-110.2).)
- operational: consolidation (W3507); operational: SLA and wave planning
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-utilization risk**: Partially-full trucks waste capacity; mitigated by consolidation (W3507)
- **Service-miss risk**: Late replenishment causes stockouts; mitigated by SLA and wave planning
System Touchpoints: - WMS/outbound (links to VS-04.2/W1368); TMS routing (links to VS-27/W3500); dock scheduling (links to VS-04/W1353); track-and-trace (links to W3508); store receiving (links to VS-07.3); freight audit (links to W3513)

steps.activity: Logistics/DC plan the outbound freight from the replenishment wave (links to VS-04.2/W1368): consolidate orders into loads by store/region/priority, select vehicle type (10-wheeler/6-wheeler per profile §7.2), apply the routing guide carrier (W3500), and sequence multi-stop routes (W3507); balance cost vs service

Logistics tender the load to the routing-guide carrier (W3501), confirm capacity/rate, schedule pickup and dock door (links to VS-04/W1353), and dispatch; manage owned-fleet (20%) vs third-party (80%) assignment per profile §7.2 and capacity

DC/Logistics load and ship (links to VS-04.2), capture shipment/manifest, transmit ASN to store (links to VS-07.3), track in-transit (W3508), and confirm delivery/receipt (links to VS-07.3); capture the rate/shipment for freight audit (W3513) and analytics (W3516)

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06.3/VS-56), Ecommerce (links to VS-10.2), 3PL/Delivery Partner (links to VS-56), Store (links to VS-07), Carrier
fields.Trigger: Ecommerce/home-delivery order (links to VS-10/VS-60); customer bulk delivery

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/Ecommerce plan last-mile delivery per the order-routing decision" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "route, customer notification, delivery and POD, and failed-delivery/returns…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "Logistics/Ecommerce capture the delivery cost per order, reconcile 3PL" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-560 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Execution, Routing Guide & Visibility (PA-110.2).)
- operational: notification and SLA; operational: cost-to-serve analytics (W3516)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Failed-delivery risk**: Missed deliveries cost re-attempts and harm CX; mitigated by notification and SLA
- **Cost-to-serve opacity risk**: Per-order delivery cost unclear; mitigated by cost-to-serve analytics (W3516)
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce/order routing (links to VS-10/VS-60); 3PL (links to VS-56); dispatch (links to W1165); returns (links to VS-32); 3PL settlement (links to VS-56.3); freight audit (links to W3513)

steps.activity: Logistics/Ecommerce plan last-mile delivery per the order-routing decision (links to VS-60/W3507): ship-from-store vs DC vs dark-store (links to VS-93) vs drop-ship, carrier/3PL selection (links to VS-56/W3500), delivery window, and bulk/heavy-item handling (white-glove links to W1208, bulk sand/cement links to W1488); manage mixed-basket orders (links to VS-60.2)

Logistics/3PL execute the last-mile delivery: dispatch (links to W1165), driver/route, customer notification, delivery and POD, and failed-delivery/returns handling (links to VS-32); manage delivery-partner SLA (links to VS-56/W1371) and customer experience (links to VS-13)

Logistics/Ecommerce capture the delivery cost per order, reconcile 3PL settlement (links to VS-56.3), feed the freight audit (W3513) and cost-to-serve (W3516), and report last-mile performance (W3512); manage delivery-charge to customer and free-delivery threshold (per profile §8.3)

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06), DC Operations (links to VS-04), IT (links to VS-27/VS-30.2), Supply Planning (links to VS-02)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/TMS optimize multi-stop routes for DC→store delivery" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "Logistics/DC consolidate loads" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validate savings vs baseline" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-560 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Execution, Routing Guide & Visibility (PA-110.2).)
- operational: TMS optimization; operational: priority rules
Pain Points / Risks: - **Suboptimal-routing risk**: Manual routing wastes miles; mitigated by TMS optimization
- **Service-vs-cost tension**: Over-consolidation delays urgent orders; mitigated by priority rules
System Touchpoints: - TMS route optimization (links to VS-27/W1369); WMS/load (links to VS-04.2); analytics (links to VS-28.1); automation/AI (links to VS-30.2)

steps.activity: Logistics/TMS optimize multi-stop routes for DC→store delivery (links to W1369/W3505) and last-mile (W3506): sequence stops, apply road/constraint data (Philippine road constraints links to W1369), vehicle capacity, time windows, and driver-hours; minimize distance/cost while meeting service

Logistics/DC consolidate loads: combine replenishment orders by store/region/priority into full-truck loads (profile §7.2: each truck fulfills 2–3 replenishment orders), co-load inbound/outbound where backhaul opportunities exist, and manage cube/weight utilization; balance consolidation vs service/urgency

Logistics/Finance measure route efficiency (cost/km, cost/stop, stops/route, load factor, empty miles/backhaul %), validate savings vs baseline (W3497), and feed continuous improvement (W3518); tune the optimization as the network/demand changes

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06), DC (links to VS-04), Store (links to VS-07), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Carrier/3PL, Customer (links to VS-13)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/Carrier track shipments in-transit via TMS/EDI/API/GPS" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "Logistics detect and triage exceptions" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "Logistics publish visibility to stakeholders" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-78 (ensure freight invoice accuracy & carrier compliance.)
- operational: track-and-trace and control tower; operational: prioritization and smart alerting
Pain Points / Risks: - **Visibility-gap risk**: Blind in-transit shipments cause surprises; mitigated by track-and-trace and control tower
- **Exception-fatigue risk**: Too many alerts; mitigated by prioritization and smart alerting
System Touchpoints: - TMS/track-and-trace (links to VS-27/W1165); GPS/telematics (links to VS-06); ecommerce customer comms (links to VS-10/VS-13); store/DC (links to VS-07.3/VS-04); typhoon (links to VS-69)

steps.activity: Logistics/Carrier track shipments in-transit via TMS/EDI/API/GPS (links to VS-27/W1165): location/status, ETA, milestones (pickup, in-transit, delivery), and exceptions (delay, damage, failed pickup/delivery); aggregate to a control-tower view across all legs

Logistics detect and triage exceptions: delay (traffic, weather/typhoon links to VS-69, port congestion), damage/loss (links to W3511/VS-90), failed delivery (links to VS-32), capacity shortfall; prioritize by impact and dispatch resolution (reroute, expedite, customer comms links to VS-13)

Logistics publish visibility to stakeholders: store ETA (links to VS-07.3), ecommerce customer tracking (links to VS-10/VS-13), DC inbound ETA (links to VS-04), and exception status; capture exceptions for analytics (W3516), carrier scorecard (W3512), and continuous improvement (W3518)

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-02.2), Import/Customs (links to VS-87), DC Operations (links to VS-04), AP (links to VS-15), Carrier/Forwarder
fields.Trigger: Port/yard delay; detention at dock; accessorial event

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/Import manage import demurrage/detention" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document and dispute unjustified charges" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validate vs contract" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-560 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Execution, Routing Guide & Visibility (PA-110.2).)
- operational: free-time monitoring and drayage discipline; operational: audit (W3513) and root cause
Pain Points / Risks: - **Demurrage-leakage risk**: Avoidable demurrage/detention erodes margin; mitigated by free-time monitoring and drayage discipline
- **Accessorial-dispute risk**: Unjustified charges paid without dispute; mitigated by audit (W3513) and root cause
System Touchpoints: - Container yard (links to VS-04/W222); dock scheduling (links to VS-04/W585); import/customs (links to VS-02.2/VS-87/W249); freight audit (links to W3513); AP (links to VS-15)

steps.activity: Logistics/Import manage import demurrage/detention (links to W249): monitor free-time expiry on containers at port/yard (links to VS-04/W222), prioritize drayage to avoid charges, and manage exceptions (port congestion, customs hold links to VS-87, typhoon links to VS-69); recover avoidable charges from responsible party

Logistics/DC manage detention and accessorial at DC/store docks (links to VS-04/W585): dock-appointment discipline to avoid carrier detention (layover, waiting time), loading/unloading turnaround, and accessorial (lumper, reefer, hazmat handling links to VS-24.3); document and dispute unjustified charges

Logistics/AP manage accessorial cost: capture demurrage/detention/accessorial on the freight invoice (W3513), validate vs contract (W3499) and root cause, dispute unjustified charges (links to VS-90), and feed root-cause/accessorial analytics (W3516) and carrier scorecard (W3512); drive reduction (W3518)

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06/W66), Supply Planning (links to VS-02/VS-05.2), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Shipping Line/RORO/Forwarder, Customs (links to VS-87 where applicable)
fields.Trigger: Inter-DC transfer (links to VS-05.2); inter-island replenishment/import distribution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/Supply Planning coordinate inter-island/inter-region freight" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation where applicable" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-allocate of "allocate to the destination island/DC/store" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-560 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Execution, Routing Guide & Visibility (PA-110.2).)
- operational: safety stock and BCP (links to VS-26/VS-69); operational: network optimization and consolidation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Island-disruption risk**: Typhoon/port congestion strands island inventory; mitigated by safety stock and BCP (links to VS-26/VS-69)
- **High-cost risk**: Inter-island freight inflates island cost-to-serve; mitigated by network optimization and consolidation
System Touchpoints: - Inter-island/vessel (links to W66/W1164); transfer (links to VS-05.2); container yard (links to VS-04/W222); visibility (links to W3508); cost allocation (links to VS-72/W3514); landed cost (links to W3515)

steps.activity: Logistics/Supply Planning coordinate inter-island/inter-region freight (links to W66/W1164): plan DC-to-DC transfers (links to VS-05.2) and DC-to-island-store replenishment across Luzon/Visayas/Mindanao, select mode (RORO, inter-island vessel, truck-ferry, air for urgent), and manage the longer transit/lead times (links to VS-02)

Logistics manage inter-island execution: booking, vessel/roro schedule, port handling, drayage at origin/destination (links to W222/W3503), customs/domestic-trade documentation where applicable (links to VS-87), and in-transit visibility (W3508); manage island-specific disruption (typhoon links to VS-69, port congestion)

Logistics/Finance capture inter-island freight cost (higher per-unit than intra-region), allocate to the destination island/DC/store (links to VS-72/W3514), feed landed cost (W3515) and cost-to-serve (W3516), and report inter-island service/cost performance (W3512); optimize network (DC catchment links to VS-04)

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-90), DC/Store (links to VS-04/VS-07), Carrier/3PL (links to VS-56), Insurance (links to VS-26), AP/AR (links to VS-15/VS-16), Legal (links to VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Loss/damage/shortage in transit (links to VS-90); delivery discrepancy

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics detect and document the in-transit loss/damage/shortage at receipt" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "file the freight claim with the carrier/3PL" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "Logistics/AP-AR settle the claim" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-78 (ensure freight invoice accuracy & carrier compliance.)
- operational: receipt-time detection and prompt filing; operational: insurance and contract liability terms
Pain Points / Risks: - **Claim-window-miss risk**: Late notice forfeits recovery; mitigated by receipt-time detection and prompt filing
- **Unrecovered-loss risk**: Carrier limits/declined claims; mitigated by insurance and contract liability terms
System Touchpoints: - Receiving/claims (links to VS-04.1/W1366/VS-90); carrier/3PL (links to VS-56); insurance (links to VS-26.3/W59); AP/AR (links to VS-15/VS-16); GL (links to VS-17); legal (links to VS-100)

steps.activity: DC/Store/Logistics detect and document the in-transit loss/damage/shortage at receipt (links to VS-04.1/W1366/VS-07.3) or customer delivery (links to W1372/VS-90): photos, POD/exception, shipment/con note, quantity/value, and notice to the carrier within the claim window (links to VS-90 short windows)

Logistics/Claims file the freight claim with the carrier/3PL (links to VS-90/W3017): claim form, supporting docs, liability per contract (W3499) and CMR/domestic rules, and negotiation; escalate to insurance (links to VS-26.3/W59) for unrecovered/consequential loss and to legal (links to VS-100) for disputes

Logistics/AP-AR settle the claim: carrier credit/refund, insurance recovery (links to VS-26.3), write-off of unrecovered loss (links to VS-35/VS-05.3), and GL posting (links to VS-17); feed claims analytics (W3516), carrier scorecard (W3512), and root-cause/capa (links to VS-90/VS-31)

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-56), Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-67), DC (links to VS-04), Store (links to VS-07), FP&A (links to VS-17.4), Carrier/3PL

workflows.name: Carrier Performance Scorecard & Quarterly Business Review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/BI compute the carrier/3PL scorecard per leg" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "Logistics/Procurement conduct the quarterly business review" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-renew of "Logistics/Procurement feed QBR outcomes to the carrier-base strategy" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-560 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Execution, Routing Guide & Visibility (PA-110.2).)
- operational: data discipline and carrier validation; operational: consequence management at QBR
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scorecard-inaccuracy risk**: Poor data undermines credibility; mitigated by data discipline and carrier validation
- **Underperformance-neglect risk**: Weak carriers retained; mitigated by consequence management at QBR
System Touchpoints: - BI/scorecard (links to VS-28.1/VS-67); QBR/contract (links to VS-56/W1439); sourcing (links to VS-03); analytics (links to W3516)

steps.activity: Logistics/BI compute the carrier/3PL scorecard per leg: on-time pickup/delivery, transit adherence, damage/loss/claims rate (W3511), invoice accuracy (W3513), cost/rate compliance (W3499), routing-guide compliance (W3500), capacity responsiveness, and HSE/safety (links to VS-24); benchmark carriers (links to VS-67 methodology)

Logistics/Procurement conduct the quarterly business review (QBR) with each core carrier/3PL (links to W1439/VS-56): performance vs SLA/contract, scorecard, root cause of issues, capacity/rate outlook, continuous-improvement actions, and relationship/strategy; manage consequences (growth, probation, exit)

Logistics/Procurement feed QBR outcomes to the carrier-base strategy (W3497), sourcing (W3498), contract renewal (W3499), routing guide (W3500), and program governance (W3520); publish the carrier scorecard to procurement/vendor management (links to VS-03/VS-67)
